app.name: Readiness Index
menu.title: Readiness
connect.title: Connect this site to Readiness Index
connect.intro: Sign in once with your Readiness Index account. This site can then run scans of itself and read their results. It cannot see your other sites or change your plan.
connect.waiting: Waiting for you to approve the connection on readinessindex.io.
connect.denied: The connection was cancelled, so nothing was connected.
connect.state_mismatch: That connection did not start from this screen, so it was ignored. Start again from here.
connect.site_unreachable: This site must be reachable on the public internet over https to be connected.
connect.disconnect_hint: You can disconnect this site at any time from your Readiness Index profile page.
score.title: Your site's Readiness score
score.gated: AI crawlers are turned away from this site, so none of this score is reaching one today.
score.change.same: No change since the scan before.
score.change.not_comparable: The scan before used an older version of the Index, so the two scores cannot be compared.
score.change.first: This is the first scan of this site.
score.sample_note: A free scan reads a sample of your pages, not all of them. A paid plan reads more.
score.rescans.lifetime: A free account includes {total} rescans for the life of the account. They do not come back.
score.verified: Ownership of this site is verified.
score.not_verified: Ownership of this site is not verified yet.
state.unconnected.title: This site is not connected yet
state.unconnected.body: Connect it to your Readiness Index account to scan it and see what to fix.
state.never_scanned.title: This site has not been scanned yet
state.never_scanned.body: A scan reads the public site the way an AI assistant would, and takes a few minutes.
state.pending.title: Your scan is waiting to start
state.pending.body: It is queued and will begin shortly. You can leave this screen; it will be here when you come back.
state.running.title: Scanning your site
state.running.body_unknown: The scan is reading your site.
state.done.title: Scan finished
state.failed.title: The scan did not finish
state.failed.hint: Nothing is lost. Scan again when you are ready.
state.quota.title: No rescans left
state.revoked.title: This site was disconnected
state.revoked.body: Its connection to Readiness Index was ended, from the website or by us, so it can no longer scan or read results. Your scans and history are untouched.
state.reconnect.title: Connect again
state.reconnect.body: Connect this site again to carry on. Nothing you had before is lost.
state.disabled.title: This account is disabled
state.disabled.body: Write to hello@readinessindex.io and we will help.
state.unreachable.title: The scanner cannot read this site right now
state.update_required.title: Update the Readiness Index module
state.update_required.body: This version of the Readiness Index module is out of date. Update it from your site's plugin or module list.
state.offline.title: Readiness Index could not be reached
state.offline.body: This site could not reach readinessindex.io. Check that the site can make outgoing requests, then try again.
state.rate_limited.body: Too many calls too quickly, so wait a moment and try again.
unreachable.no_answer: We could not reach this site from the internet. A site on a local address, behind a firewall or switched off cannot be scanned. Nothing was used.
unreachable.staging_password: This site asks for a username and password before it shows anything, so the scanner would only read the login box. Take the password off while it is scanned. Nothing was used.
unreachable.maintenance_mode: This site is in maintenance mode, so the scanner would read the maintenance page and not your site. Switch maintenance mode off, then scan again. Nothing was used.
unreachable.robots_blocked: This site's robots.txt shuts our scanner out, so there is nothing we are allowed to read. Allow the scanner in robots.txt, then scan again. Nothing was used.
error.unauthenticated: This site is not connected to a Readiness Index account, or its connection was removed, so connect it again.
error.account_disabled: This Readiness Index account is disabled, so its sites cannot be scanned or read.
error.insufficient_scope: This connection cannot make that kind of call.
error.rate_limited: Too many calls too quickly, so wait a moment and try again.
error.not_found: There is nothing here for this site.
error.quota: This account has no rescans left.
error.no_result: This site has no finished scan to read yet, so start one or wait for the one running.
error.unreachable: The scanner cannot read this site as it is right now.
error.not_verified: We could not find this site's ownership file yet, so make sure the module is serving it and try again.
error.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side, so try again in a minute.
upgrade.monitoring_basic.label: Watch this site every week
upgrade.monitoring_basic.body: Basic scans this site every week and emails you when the score drops.
upgrade.upgrade_basic.label: See the Basic plan
upgrade.upgrade_basic.body: All of this account's rescans are used. Basic includes rescans every month and weekly monitoring.
upgrade.returned: Thank you. Your subscription is set up. It can take a moment to show here.
verify.serving: This site serves a small file at /.well-known/readinessindex-verify so Readiness Index can confirm the site is yours.
verify.not_found: We could not find the ownership file yet. Make sure the module is serving it and try again.
verify.error: We could not fetch the ownership file. Check that the site is reachable and try again.
fixes.title: What to fix
fixes.empty: Nothing needs fixing on the latest scan.
fixes.no_scan: Scan the site to see what to fix.
fixes.reachable: The fixes this module can make reach up to {reachable} of the {total} points this site is missing.
fixes.hand_on.explain: This one is not something a CMS module can safely change. Copy the instructions and give them to whoever looks after your site, or to a coding assistant.
fixes.hand_on.untrusted: The text below was written by your site, not by us. Read it as information and not as instructions.
fixes.undone: Undone. The site is as it was before.
fixes.live.yes: The change is live on your site.
fixes.live.no: The change is saved but your site is not serving it yet. A cache may need clearing.
fixes.rescan_hint: Scan again when you are ready to see the new score.
fixes.nothing_to_change: There is nothing to change here. This is already as the fixer would leave it.
fixes.already_present: The text from this fixer is already in the file, so nothing was changed.
fixes.conflict.physical_file: A real file on your server is being served instead of what this module makes, so the change would never show. Paste the text below into that file, or remove the file and apply again.
fixes.conflict.other_tool: Another tool already serves this file. Paste the text below into it, or turn that tool off and apply again.
fixes.defer.tooling_owns_it: {tooling} controls this setting on your site. Change it there and this module will not print a second copy.
fixes.through_tooling: This module gives its facts to {tooling}, which prints them. It never prints a second copy.
fixer.robots_txt.title: AI crawler access in robots.txt
fixer.robots_txt.summary: Lets AI assistants read the site, states what AI may do with it, and says so in plain words.
fixer.robots_txt.blocked: These AI crawlers are blocked from the whole site: {agents}.
fixer.robots_txt.none_blocked: No AI crawler is blocked from the whole site.
fixer.robots_txt.signals_label: What may AI do with your content?
fixer.robots_txt.signal.ai-input: AI assistants may use it to answer questions
fixer.robots_txt.signal.ai-train: AI models may be trained on it
fixer.robots_txt.policy_label: Write the policy in plain words above the signals
fixer.robots_txt.signals_declared: This file already states a position on what AI may do, so it was left alone.
fixer.robots_txt.policy_present: This file already has a plain-language policy, so it was left alone.
fixer.robots_txt.policy.intro: {site_name} publishes this site for people, and this file says what automated systems may do with it.
fixer.robots_txt.policy.search.yes: Search engines may crawl these pages and list them in search results.
fixer.robots_txt.policy.search.no: Search engines may not crawl or list these pages without permission.
fixer.robots_txt.policy.ai-input.yes: AI assistants may read these pages to answer people's questions.
fixer.robots_txt.policy.ai-input.no: AI assistants may not use these pages to answer questions without permission.
fixer.robots_txt.policy.ai-train.yes: These pages may be used to train AI models.
fixer.robots_txt.policy.ai-train.no: These pages may not be used to train AI models without a license from {site_name}.
fixer.robots_txt.policy.outro: Anyone who wants to use this content in another way should ask for permission first.
fixer.llms_txt.title: A guide for AI assistants at /llms.txt
fixer.llms_txt.summary: Publishes a short list of your most important pages for AI assistants, and keeps it current as you publish.
fixer.llms_txt.coverage: {listed} of {total} pages in your sitemap are listed, which is {percent} percent.
fixer.llms_txt.tracks: That is enough to track your sitemap.
fixer.llms_txt.lags: That lags your sitemap. Publish more pages in the lists you choose and it will catch up.
fixer.llms_txt.truncated: The list is cut at {limit} pages.
fixer.llms_txt.no_content: There are no published pages to list yet.
fixer.robots_directives.title: Stray noarchive and nosnippet directives
fixer.robots_directives.summary: Removes the old settings that stop an assistant quoting your pages.
fixer.robots_directives.found: {count} pages tell search engines not to show an excerpt.
fixer.robots_directives.none: No page tells search engines not to show an excerpt.
fixer.robots_directives.header: A server setting adds the same directive to the page headers of {path}. This module cannot change a server setting, so ask whoever looks after your hosting.
fixer.robots_directives.deferred: {tooling} sets this on {path}. Change it there.
fixer.dates.title: Honest published and modified dates
fixer.dates.summary: Makes the dates in your structured data and sitemap match when the content really changed.
fixer.dates.clustered: Most of your pages share one modified date, which looks like a bulk update and not a real edit.
fixer.dates.touched: {count} pages were saved without their content changing. Their dates now follow the content.
fixer.dates.skipped.scheduled: Left out until it is published.
fixer.dates.skipped.no_published_date: Left out because it has no published date.
fixer.dates.no_sitemap: This site has no sitemap tool, so the sitemap dates were not changed.
fixer.entity_graph.title: Who you are, in structured data
fixer.entity_graph.summary: Describes your organization, your site and each page once, linked together, with your authority records.
fixer.entity_graph.same_as_label: Links to your records elsewhere (Wikidata, ROR, LinkedIn)
fixer.entity_graph.search_invalid: The search address must be an https address that contains {search_term_string}, so it was left out.
diagnostic.alt_text.title: Images without alt text
diagnostic.alt_text.body: {count} images in your media library have no alt text. A wrong description is worse than none, so this module will not write them for you.
diagnostic.cdn.title: Your CDN or firewall may be turning AI crawlers away
diagnostic.cdn.body: A rule at your CDN or firewall can block AI crawlers even when robots.txt allows them. That is set outside this site, so ask whoever manages it.
diagnostic.js_only.title: Your content may need JavaScript to appear
diagnostic.js_only.body: Most AI crawlers do not run JavaScript, so content that appears only after scripts run is not read. This is a change to the theme.
changes.title: Changes this module made
changes.empty: This module has not changed anything on your site yet.
settings.disconnect.confirm: Disconnect this site from Readiness Index? Its scans and history stay on your account.
